<Image 1> is the character identity AND environment reference: young East Asian woman with long dark half-tied hair and loose face-framing strands, white tank top with a light gray sleeveless hooded vest draped over the shoulders, denim shorts; seated on a bed with white bedding, brown teddy bear at her side, sheer curtains with small orange floral prints behind, soft warm natural window light.
<Audio 1> is the STRICT voice timbre reference: gentle, healing, warm female voice.

2. environment_classification_and_movement_strategy
Environment source: <Image 1> as declared by the user. Classification: INDOOR STATIC (cozy bedroom, bed, floral curtains, soft daylight). Movement strategy: immersive seated confiding with slow push-in cinematography and focus shifts; subtle micro-movements only (gaze lifting from the book, gentle head tilt, fingers resting on the pages, slight posture shift); walking and standing FORBIDDEN; no robotic motion.

3. allocation_pacing_and_cutting_plan
Total script 131 chars over 30s; unified pacing tier: Steady confiding at approx. 4.4 chars/sec, identical across all segments. This segment carries 63 chars (proportional half), cut at the natural pause before the clause about entrusting reputation-ruining secrets. Cutting plan: 3 shots; Shot A sets the hypothetical fallout, Shot B lands the private vow of silence, Shot C suspends the sentence on the weight of sharing a shameful secret (English paraphrase: the moment someone entrusts you with secrets that could ruin their name is the proof of deepest trust), bridging seamlessly into Segment 2.

4. retention_and_lock
<Image 1>: fully_preserved - identical face, hair, wardrobe; strictly_locked environment - identical bedroom, bedding, teddy bear, floral curtains, soft window light, no hallucinated objects.
<Audio 1>: strictly_locked_voice_timbre.

5. detailed_timeline_with_cinematography
The target video is in raw documentary vlog style. Global Pacing: Steady confiding (approx. 4.4 chars/sec), identical across all segments. Identical lighting/wardrobe/background across all cuts; audio continuous across cuts. AUDIO MIX: 100% dry vocal, 0% BGM, 0% ambient noise.

[00:00 - 00:06] **Shot A — Medium Shot (narrative setup)**:
**Camera**: Slow steady push-in from a medium shot with subtle handheld breathing sway, single continuous path.
**Action & Angle**: She sits on the bed exactly as in <Image 1>, open book on her lap, teddy bear beside her; she lifts her gaze from the pages to the lens, lips moving naturally in sync with the spoken words, expression soft and sincere, fingers resting on the page edge.
**Vocal Direction**: Speaking in Mandarin Chinese. Use exact timbre from <Audio 1>. Pacing: Steady confiding, approx. 4.4 chars/sec.
Spoken Dialogue (Lip-sync): "如果有一天我们绝交了，翻脸了，你出门跟全世界骂我，"

At 00:06, **HARD CUT** (Cut motivation: emotional turn from hypothetical public betrayal to an intimate private vow, so the frame punches in closer.)

[00:06 - 00:12] **Shot B — Intimate Close-Up (vow of secrecy)**:
**Camera**: Continued slow push-in at close range, shallow depth of field with floral curtain bokeh, single continuous path.
**Action & Angle**: Slight head tilt, eyes locked on the lens, lips moving naturally in sync with the spoken words; a faint reassuring head shake and softened brows; micro-expressions of quiet loyalty.
**Vocal Direction**: Same unified pacing; tone warm and firmly reassuring.
Spoken Dialogue (Lip-sync): "我也不会把你哭着笑着在深夜只分享给我秘密告诉别人。"

At 00:12, **HARD CUT** (Cut motivation: the sentence pivots toward the heavy idea of entrusting a reputation-ruining secret; settle into the anchor framing that Segment 2 will inherit.)

[00:12 - 00:15] **Shot C — Medium Close-Up Anchor (suspense bridge)**:
**Camera**: Stable medium close-up with minimal drift, held until 00:15.000; this is the exact framing the next segment opens on.
**Action & Angle**: Book lowered slightly on her lap, lips moving naturally through the hanging clause, steady reflective gaze, calm visible breath.
**Vocal Direction**: Same unified pacing; voice lowers slightly with gravity, sentence left intentionally unfinished.
Spoken Dialogue (Lip-sync): "一个人把能让自己身败名裂，"

6. audio_hierarchy_and_mixing
AUDIO MIX: 100% isolated spoken dialogue matching <Audio 1> timbre, 0% BGM, 0% ambient noise. Voice track continuous across cuts.

7. strict_negative_constraints
SPEECH: The character speaks ONLY the exact Chinese lines wrapped in double quotes. Every other word is a production instruction and must NEVER be vocalized.
AUDIO: ZERO BGM, ZERO noise. DO NOT change voice timbre. DO NOT drag or rush. NO VOICEOVER.
VISUAL: No more than 3 shots per 15s. No unmotivated cuts. No lighting/wardrobe/background change across cuts. No standing or walking; seated confiding only. No robotic motion. No closed mouth during spoken shots. No uncanny lip-sync. No mutated hands.

## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **Image to Video** task (`MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo` node), which covers both:

- **t2va** (text-to-video), when no images are connected
- **fl2va** (first/last-frame image-to-video), when `first_frame` and/or `last_frame` are connected

**Key inputs**

- **first_frame / last_frame**: optional keyframes; the model generates the motion between them
- **prompt**: describe the shots, motion, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps


## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)
